cards.target: Desde que me avisem, não tem problema.

existing_tips: 'Viver' + gerúndio = to always be doing something – habitual.
'Contar que' (to tell/recount that) introduces reported narratives – more personal than 'dizer que'.
'Ter que' + infinitive = to have to. Slightly more informal than 'ter de'.
'Volta e meia' = every now and then/keeps on.
